# lumos_users (Data Source)

Users DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_users" "my_users" {
  exact_match = false
  expand = [
    "..."
  ]
  search = "...my_search..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exact_match` (Boolean) Only return users whose name or email equals `search` exactly.
- `expand` (List of String) Fields to expand. Supported fields: custom_attributes.
- `search` (String) Search for users by name or email.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Users returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `custom_attributes` (Attributes Map) Custom attributes configured on the user (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--custom_attributes))
- `email` (String) The email of this user.
- `family_name` (String) The family name of this user.
- `given_name` (String) The given name of this user.
- `id` (String) The ID of this user.
- `status` (String) The status of this user.

<a id="nestedatt--users--custom_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.custom_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of custom attribute. Only text and user options are available today
- `value` (Attributes) The value of the attribute for an individual Order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--custom_attributes--value))

<a id="nestedatt--users--custom_attributes--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.custom_attributes.value`

Read-Only:

- `array_of_user` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--custom_attributes--value--array_of_user))
- `date_time` (String)
- `integer` (Number)
- `str` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--users--custom_attributes--value--array_of_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.custom_attributes.value.array_of_user`

Read-Only:
